D004-D017_h001.question:
I’ve been feeling increasingly certain that something terrible is coming—like a kind of collapse, not just personally, but globally. It’s not that I think I’m special or chosen or anything; it’s more like I *feel* it in my bones, the way the light hits things now, the way plants don’t grow the same. I design gardens for people, and even the healthiest trees, the ones thriving, they somehow feel… hollow to me now, like they’re just waiting to wither. 

There are times when I look in the mirror and notice my skin—it looks thin, almost translucent, like it’s not really mine. I don’t spend hours checking or fixing it, but sometimes I’ll avoid photos at family dinners because I worry others will see what I see: that I’m not solid anymore, like I’m becoming invisible. My husband says I look fine, great even, but how would he know? He doesn’t *feel* it. 

I don't do any special routines or rituals—I just notice. I’ve felt this way for about six months, maybe longer. It’s not constant, but when it comes, it feels absolutely true. Sometimes I check my reflection in the stainless steel just to be sure… but then I see their eyes follow me. I don’t know if I look worse or if they just notice it more. I haven’t missed a day, but I dread the shift. I just wish I knew why they’re so focused on me.  

It’s been going on for months—maybe half a year? I can’t stop thinking about it, but I haven’t told anyone. What if they think I’m imagining it? But how can I be when I *see* it?
